description: Record what the person decided about an observation itself. 'snoozed' goes quiet until a date. 'dismissed' goes quiet for 90 days and returns quoting their reason back. 'not_our_way' means this is genuinely not how this team works and the check never raises it for that seat again. 'acted_on' means they handled it. Use this whenever somebody says a suggestion is not relevant -- it is how Ollie learns to stop.
name: set_coaching_disposition
